_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gas distribution and midstream signals with ONEOK's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We are a leading midstream service provider of gathering, processing, fractionation, transportation, storage and marine export services.' 'Each of our four reportable segments are primarily fee-based, and our consolidated earnings were approximately 90% fee-based in 2025.' 'The volatility of natural gas, NGL, Refined Products and crude oil prices could adversely affect our earnings and cash flows.' (the FY2025 10-K's own words; it does not use the word cyclical, so DURABLE, the MU rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance', GENAI to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility', GLP1 to 'GLP-1 obesity drugs reduce demand for snacks, beverages, sleep-apnea/diabetes/cardio devices': none names gas distribution or midstream), so the watch list is empty; ENERGY_TRANSITION's reserves and refining are out of scope (the TRGP and BKR reading): ONEOK holds no reserves of its own and refines nothing ('We may not be able to accurately estimate hydrocarbon reserves and production volumes expected to be delivered to us for a variety of reasons, including the unavailability of sufficiently detailed information and unanticipated changes in producers’ expected drilling schedules.'); its greenhouse gas risk factor: 'We may face significant costs to comply with the regulation of GHG emissions.' (text only); its climate risk factor: 'Scrutiny and conflicting stakeholder expectations regarding ESG issues, including climate change, may impact our business.' (text only); EV and CRYPTO are out of scope: the 10-K names neither electric vehicles nor crypto (text only); GENAI and GLP1 are out of scope: the 10-K's AI words are its own computing policy ('The use of emerging technologies, including the use of Cloud Services and Artificial Intelligence, is governed by our End-User Computing Policy.') and it names no GLP-1 drug (text only); the 10-K's cloud words are its own cybersecurity vendors: 'In addition, we conduct risk assessments of new enterprise third-party software and cloud vendors by utilizing security questionnaires prior to procurement.' (text only)

BEAR.desc: EPS -53.7%/yr (worst year FY16-FY25, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +41.5%/yr (Q2 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +41.5%/yr (FY16-FY25 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +64.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY16-FY25, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: OKE (retrospective, 2026-09-25) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.43x (83.1% downside to Bear $15 / +193.4% upside to Bull $260) | Adj composite 2.45 vs market 1.51: gap +0.94 [UNDERVALUED] | +20% above the EPP floor $74 (13x FY26E $5.68) | Conservative 2-yr case: +121.9% total (+61.0%/yr) | At 15.6x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $117 sits at or below the BASE case; net margin +11.1% and Distribution operating income n/r in Q2 2026, forward revenues +52.8% (no FY26 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2026 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (CLOUD and OFFSHORE are scoped to IT, ECOMMERCE to retail, STREAMING to TV, ENERGY_TRANSITION to reserves and refining, EV to fuel retail, CRYPTO to payments and banks, GENAI to software, services and content, GLP1 to food and devices).
